value.rationale: The six-layer exact census is a complete natural dynamical invariant for every labelled wheel size and characterizes a sharp full-system transient cutoff, the number of primitive recurrent orbits, extinction basin and two distinct spectral growth rates. Almost surely (as wheel length grows), a uniform state first enters an attracting primitive three-cycle at exactly the second update. These quantify properties not obtained from the older qualitative graph-general synchronization theorem.
